name: San Giustino (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Giustino (scales and a sword on blue beneath a chief of six balls) within branches, with the name SAN GIUSTINO on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of San Giustino, a comune in Umbria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Giustino arms — scales and a sword on blue beneath a chief of six balls, crowned, within branches
